text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaap!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... And that was my secret
technique,
Bakushin Ring Toss!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-wow! My eyes couldn't keep up with
how fast
you threw all six rings!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-though, they all missed the mark...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pew! Pew! Pew! Pew! Zap!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
All hits confirmed. Targets down.
Operation
Target Shooting was a
success.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Amazing! Bourbon, you're so cool!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you used the right gun, though?! And are those holes in the prizes?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Look at this wafer cutout design I made!
You can
get the wafers from the stand
over there.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a bird! You even etched out all its
feathers.
It's so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, hehe. I got so engrossed in
carving
out the design, I couldn't help
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Emotional response... verified. The
object meets the requirements to be
considered a work of art. I
recommend
photographic preservation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then how about you include my wafer
design in
the shot too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When did you even have the time?!
But... huh?
You're not holding anything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That is not by mistake! I added a little
Bakushin
and the whole thing turned to
dust!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think you've Bakushined a
little too
much? And I don't just mean
this time...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Rice, you sure know how to chow down!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? I... I do?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Course you do! You were just holding a
meat bun a second ago! Or—don't tell
me—that was a
magic trick?! Everyone's
so unique. I'm... I'm...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm having so much fun! This might be
just a
regular festival, but I feel like I'm
at an amusement park! I wanna do something
interesting too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Your smile is like a blossoming
flower. It
really brightens up the
place. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I agree... Hehe, I'm so glad I get to have
fun with
everyone. ♪
